## Before the Exam

1.  🧹 Clear your desk of everything except a pen/pencil, cheat sheet, and ID.

\

2.  🧢 Remove hats, hoods, and sunglasses.

\

3.  📱 All electronic devices (laptop, phone, airbuds, smart watch) should be remain in your bag for the entire class period.

\

4.  Spread out as much as possible.


## Exam

```{r}
#countdown::countdown(minutes = 170, bottom = 0)
```

1.  Write your name on __Bubble__ sheet and __Free-Response__ sheet.

2.  If you need to use the bathroom, bring phone, exam and ID to the front.

3.  ⌛If you finish early, bring exam and ID to the front of the class.

4.  ⌛If you finish  within the last 5 mins, please hold on to your exam and wait.

5.  ❗You must stop writing when time is called or risk a 0.

Good luck! 🍀
